seo.title: Work with ODD — ODDference, ODDnetwork, partnerships and ODDagency
seo.description: Ways for organisations to work with ODD — come to ODDference, stay involved through ODDnetwork, build an event partnership, or bring us a project through ODDagency.

title: Work with us.
intro: ODD works with organisations that want to get closer to creative thinking, people and culture — through events, ongoing relationships, partnerships and projects.

whatWeDo.headline: Different ways to build something together.
whatWeDo.body: We create events, spaces and relationships that bring creative and cultural expertise closer to business and wider society: ODDference, ODDfest, ODDspace, ODDnetwork, and the partnerships and projects that grow out of them. Organisations can join that work in several ways — from attending ODDference to building a project with us from scratch.

whyOdd.title: We work from inside the creative fields
whyOdd.body: ODD is built through actual events, spaces and relationships with people working across creative and cultural fields — not a database of contacts.

whyOdd.title: We connect worlds that don't meet often enough
whyOdd.body: ODD regularly operates across creative, cultural, business and public-sector contexts. The value is partly being able to bring different perspectives into the same work without pretending they're all the same.

whyOdd.title: We build around the actual need
whyOdd.body: A collaboration doesn't need to fit a predefined sponsorship package or agency product. It can start with an event, a question, a project, a partnership or simply a conversation.

pathways.meta: The easiest way to experience ODD
pathways.title: ODDference
pathways.body: Attend yourself, bring a team, or start a conversation around ODDference.

pathways.title: ODDnetwork
pathways.body: ODDnetwork is being shaped as a year-round way for organisations to stay close to the people, questions and activity around ODD.

pathways.title: Event partnerships
pathways.body: Support something that already exists, bring resources or expertise, or create a programme or experience together. Tell us what you want to make possible and let's see what we could build.

pathways.meta: A concrete brief, question or idea
pathways.title: ODDagency
pathways.body: Bring us a brief, a question or an unfinished idea. We shape the work with you and bring in the people it actually needs.

contact.title: What are you working on?
contact.body: Tell us what you're trying to do, change, understand or build. You don't need to know which ODD pathway fits yet — we can work that out together.
